in_sanskrit.name: कल्प
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The word 'Kalp' in Sanskrit has various meanings, primarily associated with the concept of desire, wish, hope, and plan. It can also mean cycle, era, eon, or even a model or prototype. The root of this word is 'Kar', meaning 'to do'. Thus, 'Kalp' can be seen as a collection or cycle of actions or a plan or design for the future.

in_hindi.name: कल्प
in_hindi.long_meaning: The word 'Kalp' in Hindi has the same meaning as in Sanskrit, which is 'wish, desire, hope, plan'. It can also mean 'work' or 'deed'. The root of this word is 'Karna', which means 'to do'. Thus, 'Kalp' can be seen as an action or deed that one plans or desires to do.

in_tamil.name: கல்பம்
in_tamil.long_meaning: The word 'Kalpam' in Tamil has the meaning 'wish, desire, hope, plan'. It can also mean 'container' or 'receptacle'. The root of this word is 'Kal', which means 'to do'. Thus, 'Kalpam' can be seen as a plan or design for an action, or a container or receptacle for holding something.

in_telugu.name: కల్పప
in_telugu.long_meaning: The word 'Kalpupu' in Telugu has the meaning 'wish, desire, hope, plan'. It can also mean 'ripe' or 'mature'. The root of this word is 'Kalp', which means 'to do'. Thus, 'Kalpupu' can be seen as a plan or design for an action, or a ripe or mature state that one desires or hopes for.

in_marathi.name: Kalp
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kalp हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A cosmic cycle or a divine plan of creation and manifestation. It represents the power of imagination and the ability to bring ideas to life. The name Kalp is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Kalpa', which means 'eon' or 'cosmic cycle'.
